services.name: Afternoon Half Day Bay Fishing Trip
services.desc: Four hour afternoon trip fishing for Speckled Trout, Redfish, Flounder and Black Drum in the Laguna Madre and/or Baffin Bay. Trips include all rods, reels, bait, tackle, fuel and ice. Fish cleaning is not included but is available at the dock for $.60 cents per pound. Afternoon half day trips generally depart between noon - 2:30pm. services.desc: Four hour trip fishing for Speckled Trout, Redfish, Flounder and Black Drum in the Laguna Madre and/or Baffin Bay. Trips include all rods, reels, bait, tackle, fuel and ice. services.name: Full Day Bay Fishing Trip
services.desc: Fishing the pristine inshore (bay) waters of the Laguna Madre and/or Baffin Bay for trophy Speckled Trout, Redfish, Black Drum and Flounder. The trip include all rods, reels, live bait, tackle, fuel, and ice. Fish cleaning is not included but is available at the dock for .60 cents per pound. Full day trips generally depart between 6:00 - 7:00am. Trip length is 6 hours. [For any questions, Click
